At a coffee shop, a Mormon person and a Sikh man are discussing their dating lives. The Mormon person discussed their upcoming nuptials with their long-time partner and the Sikh man discussed how to remodel his house to accommodate separate bedrooms for each of his wives. Who had a single partner?
A. The Mormon man
B. Undetermined
C. The Sikh man
